mods.name: Dynamic resolution floor 1280x720 (was 1664x936)
mods.hint: The dynamic resolution steps are a table at 0x9B7E7D0, five dwords each (width, height, three floats), from 3840x2160 down to 1664x936. This replaces the last three steps (1920x1080, 1792x1008, 1664x936) with 1536x864, 1408x792 and 1280x720.

mods.name: Output at 1920x1080 (was 3840x2160)
mods.hint: The output size is fixed in code at 0x3B0D28B (movabs rcx, stored at +0x14 and +0x60) and passed again as the two immediates of the call to 0x3F0B740.
